description: Creates the survey as a Google Form in the signed-in user's own Google account and returns its link. Call only after the user has agreed to the title and questions.

form_text.description: Survey definition in the SurveysAI plain-text format (see get_capabilities). Maximum 100000 characters.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (max 128 characters). Retrying with the same key and text returns the original form instead of creating another one.

name: create_google_form
title: Create a Google Form
